Quick technical read:

- Section 3.2 (replication) — Apex's definition of "cross-region replication" is asynchronous snapshot-based. That will not preserve in-memory KV cache consistency; we need either a stronger consistency note or explicit statement that their replication window is eventually consistent with a max RPO of 15 minutes.
- Section 4 (retention policy) — limits are fine but we need a clause for emergency purge requests (legal/incident response) with a 24-hour SLA and audit proof.
- Performance bump: they add a 20% cost uplift for heavy manifest churn. We should get specific thresholds (ops/sec, average manifest size) rather than a flat % on our baseline.

I've attached quick redlines (Apex_SOW_redline_v2.docx) with inline comments for the above. Dev, please skim the comments marked "impact: runtime" and flag anything you're not comfortable with.

-Karthik
Director, Platform Engineering

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Updated SOW & retention add-on pricing — redlines and next steps

Sam — thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the SOW internally and attached a redline (Apex_SOW_redline_v2.docx). High-level asks and action items:

- Retention/replication: Add explicit RPO/RTO targets (15m RPO max for replicated manifests) and an "emergency purge" process (24-hour response + audit log export).
- Pricing: we can consider the 12-month commit if the migration credit (60 days) applies per-cluster and the heavy-manifest uplift is replaced with a threshold-based formula (e.g., >10k manifest churn/day triggers review).
- Liability / data ownership: Marissa, please propose contract language limiting vendor liability to direct damages and preserving our ownership of metadata and deleted-object logs.
- Timeline: we'd like an updated SOW and a DocuSign packet by EOD for review in procurement.

Please confirm the DocuSign route vs redline negotiation. If legal prefers redlines, we will return comments; otherwise we're prepared to sign a clean packet if your team can accept the items above.

Action items (owners):
- Apex: update SOW + confirm pricing formula (Sam) — due EOD today
- Marissa: redline/LGTM for risk items — due EOD today
- Karthik/Dev: final tech sign-off on RPO wording — due tomorrow noon

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Updated SOW & retention add-on pricing — redlines and next steps

Vanessa / team — thanks for the clear notes and the redline. Agreeable on most points. Summary and next steps:

- We accepted the emergency purge clause (24-hour response) and inserted an audit log export workflow into section 3.4.
- Replication RPO: we can commit to 15-minute RPO for replicated manifests in standard regions; for cross-continental replication (EU <-> US) we keep the "review" caveat due to network overhead — listed as an exception in the SOW.
- Pricing: replaced flat manifest uplift with threshold formula: >10k manifest churn/day = review; migration credit clarified as "60 days of waived add-on fees per cluster" when signing a 12-month add-on.
- We uploaded an updated SOW and prepared a DocuSign packet: https://docu.sign/Apex/SOW/APX-REG-2026-12.

If you want a redline exchange with legal, we can support that, but given the timeline we can also route the DocuSign packet for signature and add any leftover legal edits as an amendment.

Please confirm whether procurement should sign the packet or if you want to route a final redline to legal first.

Thanks,
Sam Park
Account Executive — Apex Registry
